sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B | Awesome Agents
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is the largest model in the Qwen 3.5 Small Series and arguably the most impressive for what it hits relative to its size. At 9 billion parameters, it beats the previous generation's Qwen3-30B on most language benchmarks and dominates GPT-5-Nano and Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite on vision tasks by double-digit margins.

sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is a native multimodal large language model from the Qwen team with 9B parameters. As a lightweight dense model in the Qwen3.5 series, it features an efficient hybrid architecture combining Gated Delta Networks with Gated Attention, natively supporting a 262K context length extensible up to ~1M tokens.
